weight_policy.packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble
weight_policy.row_scale: preserve the authenticated normalized 32-bit Scale32 record for every output row

codebook_record.entry_format: signed Q4.4 two's-complement int8; -128 is legal in this weight-codebook domain
codebook_record.entry_order: strictly increasing; byte offset equals payload index

construction_algorithm.data_source: pinned BF16 weights and authenticated row Scale32 records only
construction_algorithm.normalization: For each scalar weight, decode its row Scale32 record exactly and form weight divided by row_scale, then round normalization times 16 to signed Q4.4 with round-to-nearest ties-to-even; any value outside [-128,+127] fails closed.
construction_algorithm.histogram: Build an exact integer histogram over all normalized Q4.4 values in the Linear tensor.
construction_algorithm.assignment: Assign every occupied histogram bin to the nearest codepoint; exact distance ties select the lower codebook index.
construction_algorithm.update: Replace each non-empty codepoint by the histogram-weighted mean rounded to nearest ties-to-even; an empty cluster retains its prior codepoint.
construction_algorithm.post_iteration_rule: Sort ascending after every update; duplicate or out-of-range codepoints fail closed rather than being repaired.
construction_algorithm.final_payload_assignment: Assign each normalized weight to the nearest final codepoint with the same lower-index tie rule.

pre_attempt_model_only_gate.uniform_baseline: the consumed dynamic V2 authenticated signed-int4 per-output-row Scale32 weight construction
pre_attempt_model_only_gate.per_tensor_error_rule: sum-squared BF16 reconstruction error may not increase for any of the 169 Linear tensors
pre_attempt_model_only_gate.aggregate_error_rule: aggregate sum-squared BF16 reconstruction error across all 169 Linear tensors must decrease strictly
pre_attempt_model_only_gate.codebook_identity_rule: two independent constructions must produce byte-identical payload, row-scale, codebook, and state manifests

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.base_record_source: the same frozen authenticated Scale32 significands used by consumed dynamic V2
activation_policy.selection_rule: For each live finite group, preserve the base Scale32 significand and choose the minimum integer exponent delta in [-24,+24] whose effective exponent remains in [-24,+4] and covers every lane without saturation.
activation_policy.failure_rule: If no legal delta covers a finite group, fail closed; never clip, saturate, or mutate the base record.

accelerator_facing_format.weight_payload_transport: existing 128-bit external-memory read channel; packed 4-bit indices retain the existing byte count
accelerator_facing_format.codebook_transport: one aligned 128-bit read beat per Linear tensor before its weight stream is consumed
accelerator_facing_format.cache_policy: two 16-byte banks permit current and next Linear codebooks; no per-token codebook traffic is permitted
accelerator_facing_format.row_scale_transport: existing 32-bit Scale32 row records remain unchanged
accelerator_facing_format.compute_primitive: signed A8 activation multiplied by signed Q4.4 int8 codepoint, accumulated as an integer product, then combined with the authenticated row Scale32 and the fixed codebook fractional shift of four
